purpose: Separate what Flower actually applied, what prior states violated, and what we infer after the fact so historical recurrence can generate prospective tests without becoming causal mythology.

episodes.observedTrigger: Identical proposal/evidence pairs were repeatedly reevaluated.
episodes.decisionRelevantMove: Reuse semantically equivalent assessments and reopen only on materially new evidence.
episodes.observedOutcome: 99 of 100 rediscoveries reused prior assessments with the same decision semantics.
episodes.falsifier: Reuse changes decision semantics or blocks materially new evidence.

episodes.observedTrigger: The first-Fruit experiment accumulated internal sophistication around early branches while confirmed economic Fruit remained zero and the user supplied many repeated Flower prompts.
episodes.decisionRelevantMove: Treat local optimization without challenger pressure or terminal conversion as a failed allocation pattern.
episodes.observedOutcome: Working artifacts and infrastructure increased while settled creator revenue remained zero.
episodes.falsifier: A comparable local-optimization-first run reaches terminal Fruit faster with lower human burden and no branch lock-in.

episodes.observedTrigger: Proxy progress, branch momentum, and terminal value had been conflated.
episodes.decisionRelevantMove: Separate terminal outcome from proxies and add challenger, fulfillment, branch-metabolism, and action membranes.
episodes.observedOutcome: Internal activity no longer counted as Fruit and branch replacement/action pressure became executable.
episodes.falsifier: Comparable runs add search churn or delay terminal action without improving selection.

episodes.observedTrigger: The first regenerative evaluator created separate value/return/cost/ownership fields but accepted populated narrative strings as strong evidence.
episodes.decisionRelevantMove: Record that causal differentiation alone did not protect truth when the split states lacked independent provenance gates.
episodes.observedOutcome: Narrative claims could still self-promote into external-value and ownership truth until verified-state gates were added.
episodes.falsifier: A split-state evaluator without provenance gates cannot be induced to self-promote narrative claims under the same tests.

episodes.observedTrigger: Revenue and useful production still did not prove external value, attributable return, full-cost surplus, ownership, or regeneration.
episodes.decisionRelevantMove: Keep those states separate and require upstream verified provenance before strong promotion.
episodes.observedOutcome: Strong regenerative state could no longer be manufactured by narrative fields alone.
episodes.falsifier: Verified-state gates add burden without preventing any materially wrong decision or attribution.

episodes.observedTrigger: Canonical v4 existed in state/docs while the active reasoner still reconstructed older passivity-first objectives.
episodes.decisionRelevantMove: Make executable cognition receive the canonical methodology itself.
episodes.observedOutcome: The reasoner began receiving current methodology and complete value/return/cost/regeneration constraints.
episodes.falsifier: Methodology-bearing cognition adds cost without improving or changing any decision.

episodes.observedTrigger: x402 activity, buyer breadth, repeat use, advertised supply, and settled flow diverged sharply.
episodes.decisionRelevantMove: Instrument flow before creating more supply, but keep the rule local until it generalizes.
episodes.observedOutcome: Internal market search improved, but one habitat did not justify universal promotion.
episodes.falsifier: Across other habitats, flow instrumentation fails to improve decisions or costs more than the uncertainty it removes.

episodes.observedTrigger: Internal improvements could be trapped inside Flower or prematurely productized as external value.
episodes.decisionRelevantMove: Prove internal gain first, then permit one bounded transfer hypothesis without external-value promotion.
episodes.observedOutcome: One transfer pass could produce an unverified seed and converge while context-specific gains could remain internal.
episodes.falsifier: Transfer analysis usually creates generic abstractions, repeated cognition, or terminal delay.

episodes.observedTrigger: Observed CI latency fell from roughly 29 ms to roughly 19 ms while the causal implementation fingerprint was unchanged.
episodes.decisionRelevantMove: Do not call an attractive metric movement improvement when comparability/causal identity is absent.
episodes.observedOutcome: The Observatory correctly reported no self-improvement despite a large favorable timing movement.
episodes.falsifier: Controlled repeated timing establishes a causal speed gain despite an unchanged declared causal implementation fingerprint, revealing the fingerprint model is incomplete.

episodes.observedTrigger: Targeted cognition stayed sparse while target-neighborhood resolution still examined 10,000 records for a 5,000-center Garden.
episodes.decisionRelevantMove: Separate transmitted-state size from activation-work cost before changing activation architecture.
episodes.observedOutcome: The hidden-work problem is measured, but no improvement is claimed until a causal intervention beats the same workload and decision witness.
episodes.falsifier: A causal activation intervention cannot reduce record visits without degrading the same decision witness or complexity capacity.
